source_layout.name: medical-ppt-design
branding_stripped: Starbucks Green system as product brand

academic_reference_only.note: The 10-set academic template library (output/academic_templates) remains style/QA reference only and is NOT a runtime fill source.

evidence_takeaways.note: 3–4 number-led conclusions; each carries superscript evidence ids → refs (source doc + page) in footer, plus verbatim quote + loc column (FactPPT verbatim tracing).

comparison.note: Dual-column contrast (e.g. 急性加重 vs 稳定期). table_2n uses rows[] instead of left/right_items.

flow.note: Horizontal/vertical stepwise pathway (诊断路径 / 阶梯治疗). 4–6 nodes.

timeline.note: Case course milestone track 就诊→检查→治疗→随访. 4 or 6 nodes.

algorithm_tree.note: Suspected→confirm algorithm with solid/dashed branch conditions (FEV1/FVC thresholds).

assessment_matrix.note: mMRC/CAT × exacerbation history → groups A/B/E with numeric thresholds.

dual_path_tree.note: CME dual-column escalation: dyspnea pathway vs exacerbation pathway (LABA/LAMA/ICS).

trial_design.note: Screening → randomisation (ratio, N) → arms with n → treatment → follow-up on a week axis; inclusion + endpoint hierarchy + number-led design facts.

forest_plot.note: Subgroup table + forest plot in one aligned SVG: n columns, RR/HR + 95% CI text, log axis, ref line at 1, one highlighted row, favours labels.

endpoint_readout.note: Main endpoint chart (bar with 95% CI error bars, or line over weeks with CI whiskers + n-at-risk row) + stats box + number-led rail. KM is a planned sub-variant.

moa_cascade.note: Structural MoA cascade: stage headers with flow arrows, item boxes, drug-action callouts with inhibition (T-bar) connectors routed in gutters. No illustrations.

cells.note: one per column, in column order

data_table_highlight.note: Data table, 3–18 rows, 1–4 data columns, zebra greys, at most one highlighted row, footnotes. Optional takeaway rail (3–4 number-led); without it the table spans the body and wording cells wrap left-aligned (teaching tables).

landscape_swimlane.note: Lanes per drug class; Phase III study bars on a year axis; end marker met / not met / ongoing (shape + text), today line, legend.

native_hook.note: pipeline.run: selector -> fill -> HTML -> Playwright measure -> python-pptx native text boxes/tables/shapes/connectors/freeforms (no bitmaps). See docs/TEMPLATE_LIB_V1.md.

craft_note.paid_quality: v1.2 premium_clinical — tonal panels; v1.3 gold_clinical — GOLD teaching density (algorithm/matrix/dual-path); v1.3.1 pharma — chart-led congress/IR data pages (trial design, forest, endpoint readout, MoA, data table, swimlane, evidence takeaways)
ban: decorative illustrations / icons on data pages
